name: What information does my dental practice need to provide to start with AI SEO?
description: Provide website analytics, Google My Business access, service lists, target demographics, and unique selling propositions to start AI SEO.

mainEntity.name: What information does my dental practice need to provide to start with AI SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: To begin AI SEO for your dental practice, you typically need to provide access to your current website analytics (like Google Analytics and Google Search Console), your Google My Business profile, and a list of your primary services and target patient demographics. Information about your unique selling propositions, any specific patient types you wish to attract (e.g., cosmetic dentistry, family dentistry), and your main geographic service areas is also crucial. This data allows AI tools to accurately assess your current online performance and tailor an effective optimization strategy.
acceptedAnswer.description: Provide website analytics, Google My Business access, service lists, target demographics, and unique selling propositions to start AI SEO.
